archive-room.name: Central Archive Room
archive-room.description: You stand in the dusty archives, holding the cursed Necronomicon. The only exit is back through the Entrance Hall.

library-entrance.name: Library Entrance Hall
library-entrance.description: The Director of the Library has blocked the main exit! He is furious and intends to lock you in forever.

city-square.name: Poznań City Square
city-square.description: You finally made it out! The fresh air of the Poznań City Square hits your face, but you still need to legalize your possession of the tome.

stun-spray.name: Archival Stun Spray
stun-spray.description: A spray bottle filled with strong chemical cleaner, effective at blinding hostile officials.

official-stamp.name: Official Library Stamp
official-stamp.description: An official rubber stamp. Getting it is the only way to prove you had permission to take the book.

director.name: Director Kowalski
director.description: The corrupt Director of the library who wants to confiscate the book and cover up its existence.

dialogues.before_talk: Director Kowalski: You! You have the Necronomicon! You will never leave this library with it! I am locking the doors!
dialogues.after_talk: Director Kowalski: Surrender the book, or I will call the guards!
dialogues.after_satisfied: Director Kowalski: You shouldn't see this.
dialogues.hostile: Director Kowalski: Aaargh! My eyes! The chemical spray!
